title: Courtesy Transportation Agreements Program Eligibility Schedule
content:
Kessler Automotive Group writes Courtesy Transportation Agreements under six programs. This schedule states, program by program, who each program is open to, the pay bases under which it may be issued, the repair-order and appointment thresholds that apply to a dealer-courtesy loaner, and how many agreements of the program one customer may have out at once.

## 1. Entry conditions

| Program | Entry conditions |
|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | An open repair order and a valid driver's license |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | An open repair order and a valid driver's license |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | An open repair order and a valid driver's license |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | An open repair order and a valid driver's license |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | An open repair order and a covered repair carrying a rental allowance |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | A fleet business customer holding an active commercial fleet service account |

## 2. Pay bases, thresholds and open-agreement limit

The pay basis records who pays the days of the agreement. Each program may be issued only under the pay bases listed for it.

| Program | Eligible pay bases | Minimum labor hours sold on the repair order (dealer courtesy) | Scheduled service appointment required (dealer courtesy) | Reservation lead, calendar days | Most agreements of the program out at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | dealer courtesy; customer rental | 1.0 | No | 0 | 1 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | dealer courtesy; customer rental | 2.0 | Yes | 2 | 1 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | dealer courtesy; customer rental | 2.0 | Yes | 2 | 1 |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | dealer courtesy; customer rental | 3.0 | Yes | 3 | 1 |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | warranty allowance; service contract allowance | 0.0 | No | 0 | 1 |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | fleet contract | 0.0 | No | 1 | 5 |

Column meanings, as the program charter defines them:

- **Eligible pay bases**: the list of pay basis values the program may be issued under.
- **Minimum labor hours**: the least labor hours sold on the repair order for a dealer-courtesy loaner.
- **Appointment required**: a switch stating whether a dealer-courtesy loaner requires a scheduled service appointment.
- **Reservation lead**: the calendar days ahead a loaner must be reserved with the appointment.
- **Most agreements out at once**: the most agreements of the program one customer may have out at the same time.

## 3. Reading the schedule

- Dealer courtesy appears as a pay basis only for the Same-Day Courtesy Loaner and the three Courtesy Loaner programs (Compact, Midsize, SUV). The Warranty Rental Loaner is issued only under a warranty allowance or a service contract allowance, and the Fleet Replacement Unit only under a fleet contract.
- Among the dealer-courtesy programs, only the Same-Day Courtesy Loaner is shown without a scheduled-appointment requirement; Compact, Midsize and SUV require one.
- The Fleet Replacement Unit allows up to 5 agreements of that program out at once; every other program allows 1.

## 4. Illustrative threshold readings (hypothetical repair orders)

| Hypothetical case | Program's minimum | Labor hours sold | Threshold met |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dealer-courtesy Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 3.0 | 3.0 | Yes, the minimum is reached |
| Dealer-courtesy Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 3.0 | 2.5 | No, below the minimum |
| Dealer-courtesy Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 2.0 | 2.0 | Yes, the minimum is reached |
| Dealer-courtesy Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | 1.0 | 0.5 | No, below the minimum |

The labor-hour figures in the right-hand columns are invented for illustration only.
